# Vue.js UI Task

Implement the requested Vue 3 UI using `agents/vue-ui.agent.md`.

Before coding, inspect existing routes, components, tokens, UI library, and conventions. For Figma or image input, record layout, typography, spacing, colors, assets, interaction, and responsive evidence first. Use `<script setup lang="ts">`, typed props/emits, semantic HTML, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 with WCAG 2.2 Level AA target, and loading/empty/error/pending/success/validation states where relevant. Validate with the project's lint, typecheck, unit/component, and browser tests.
